title.narrative: UNITAR: High Level Seminar on Peace and Security in Africa

description.narrative: Denmark’s participation in and support of the annual High-Level Seminar on peace and security with the AU Peace and Security Council members (AUPSC) and the three African elected countries to the UN Security Council (A3) offers a unique platform listen to African countries discuss peace and security priorities and how Denmark can meaningfully support solutions. The Seminar is co-organized by United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR), and Denmark has been invited to provide financial support through UNITAR, with Switzerland and Norway as other partners. To this effect, the Danish Minister for Development Corporation and Global Climate Policy has decided to allocate DKK 2.000.000 in support of the meetings in December 2023 and 2024. The contribution fulfils the DAC criteria. BoA for the year ended on 31 December 2022 finds UNITAR’s ‘overall financial position sound with high levels of capital structure ratios’.

Support to UNITAR to organize the annual High Level Seminar on Peace and Security in Africa between the AU PSC and the African elected members of the UN Security Council.
Strategic objectives:
Engagement with the AUPSC and A3 members states at the ministerial level to foster stronger partnerships around African peace- and security matters.
A3 High-Level seminar serves as platform for understanding priorities and solutions to conflict resolution and mitigation.
Outcomes of expected Danish elected seat in the UN Security Council are expected to increase if alliance is built with A3 countries around shared international peace and security positions.
